Generated seccomp filter allowing write and fsync only on logfile_fd.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for the archiver feeder process. It selects the target architecture with `ARCH_NR`, then builds a 14-instruction `sock_filter` program in `populate_sock_filter_policy_archiver_feeder()` that allows only `write` and `fsync` system calls under fixed argument checks. The policy permits `write` only when file descriptor `2` or `logfile_fd` is used, and permits `fsync` only for `logfile_fd`; all other system calls or mismatched architectures cause `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`.
